help.bind:
Explicitly confirm this repository's product for automatic capture

Usage:
  zensu ai-work bind [flags]

Flags:
      --confirm          confirm the user's explicit choice of this product
  -h, --help             help for bind
      --json             output raw JSON (the default for this command)
      --product string   confirmed product UUID (required)

Global Flags:
      --api-url string   Zensu API base URL (overrides stored host and ZENSU_API_URL)
help.context:
Revalidate a confirmed repository product; never creates work

Usage:
  zensu ai-work context [flags]

Flags:
      --cross-product             read the current identity for an explicitly requested cross-product goal
      --feature string            validate this goal's feature against the confirmed product
      --feature-revision string   validate an optional revision of the selected feature
  -h, --help                      help for context
      --json                      output raw JSON (the default for this command)

Global Flags:
      --api-url string   Zensu API base URL (overrides stored host and ZENSU_API_URL)
help.start:
Declare an agreed work objective (retry with the same ID)

Usage:
  zensu ai-work start [flags]

Flags:
      --cross-product-reason string   explicit reason for this cross-product goal; never a repository default
      --feature string                explicitly chosen feature UUID for this goal; determines its product
      --feature-revision string       optional revision UUID belonging to the chosen feature
  -h, --help                          help for start
      --id string                     stable work UUID (required; keep across retries)
      --json                          output raw JSON (the default for this command)
      --maintenance-reason string     explicit reason for product maintenance without a feature, for this goal only
      --product string                explicit product UUID; plugins must match a confirmed repository binding
      --run-kind string               work or test; use test only for explicit validation/demo/probe runs (default "work")
      --source string                 reporter: cli, codex, claude_code, antigravity, copilot or kiro (client declaration) (default "cli")
      --source-version string         reporter version (plugins must supply their own version) (default "0.18.0")
      --title string                  agreed work objective, at most 160 characters
      --work-order string             optional canonical work-order UUID

Global Flags:
      --api-url string   Zensu API base URL (overrides stored host and ZENSU_API_URL)
help.get:
Read the current result and authenticated capture history

Usage:
  zensu ai-work get <work-id> [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for get
      --json   output raw JSON (the default for this command)

Global Flags:
      --api-url string   Zensu API base URL (overrides stored host and ZENSU_API_URL)
help.submit:
Submit an immutable result version; never accepts it

Usage:
  zensu ai-work submit <work-id> [flags]

Flags:
      --artifact string           immutable commit or document version reference
      --criteria-version string   version or digest of the agreed acceptance criteria
      --event-id string           stable submission UUID (required; keep across retries)
      --expected-version int32    observed work version; stale writes conflict
  -h, --help                      help for submit
      --json                      output raw JSON (the default for this command)
      --review-file string        explicit JSON file containing implementation summary, acceptanceCriteria, evidence and optional limitations (max 32 KiB)

Global Flags:
      --api-url string   Zensu API base URL (overrides stored host and ZENSU_API_URL)
